before_metrics.c_enabled_summary: A+B+C with only 20260420 and 20260421 snapshots present

change_summary: Added historical `as_of` support to `quant/data_layer.py`, including future-safe extraction of the next earnings row and past-only surprise history. Added `quant/backfill_earnings_snapshots.py` to prefetch each ticker's earnings timeline once and persist `earnings_snapshot_YYYYMMDD.json` across a requested trading-day range. Validated with 7 targeted tests, then backfilled the full primary window (`2025-10-23 -> 2026-04-20`), producing 129 archived snapshot days available to the backtester.

delta_metrics.note: This was a measurement/parity repair. The deliverable is full historical P-ERN coverage plus proof that archived earnings fields now flow into historical feature construction without future leakage.

hypothesis: If `C strategy revival` is still the best blocked alpha direction, the first credible next step is not another C threshold tweak but a full historical P-ERN archive. Extending `data_layer.get_earnings_data()` with an `as_of` view and adding a backfill path should make `eps_estimate` and historical surprise replayable across the whole primary window without leaking future reports.

market_regime_summary.primary: measurement repair only; no strategy rule changed

next_retry_requires: Use the repaired archive to re-test `earnings_event_long` against the same A+B baseline before making any new C-specific rule change
Do not assume data repair alone revives C; the follow-up still needs Gate 4 multi-window evidence
notes: The key success condition was archive availability, not an immediate alpha gain. This run converts P-ERN from a two-day snapshot trickle into a usable historical replay archive.

get_earnings_data.new: supports historical as_of with no future surprise leakage
get_earnings_data.old: current-day only, no historical as_of view
